purpose: Two fixed development records: diverse normal-load initialization only; unchanged fault scenario; no guaranteed improvement

evaluation.primary_signal: quality_alarm, with handler_time_alarm and http_error_alarm reported separately
evaluation.ipca_signal: statistical_alarm independently of message_kind and quality_alarm
evaluation.event_time: UTC command send/ack bracket; monotonic deadlines; per-request served_mode retained for audit only
evaluation.earliest_stage_end: min(command send + duration, next stage first command send, scheduled UTC end); final stage uses scheduled UTC end
evaluation.eligible_window: window start >= main command acknowledgment; window end <= earliest_stage_end; boundary windows listed separately
evaluation.on_time_detection: matching signal on eligible faulty window AND emitted_at < earliest_stage_end
evaluation.false_service_alarms: quality_alarm on the contiguous healthy span from normal acknowledgment until earliest delay start; windows crossing normal-to-load are INCLUDED; count seconds and contiguous groups
evaluation.healthy_ipca_warnings: all statistical_alarm on the contiguous pre-fault healthy span INCLUDING normal-to-load transition; report recovery healthy windows separately, even when quality_alarm is false
evaluation.recovery: one recovery after both adjacent faults; emitted after recovery acknowledgment and before recovery send + 20 seconds; exactly ten consecutive good windows required
evaluation.partial_boundary_windows: retained, counted separately, never silently treated as normal or used to claim precise onset
evaluation.ipca_success: IPCA on-time detection and healthy-warning counts reported independently; service rules cannot satisfy the IPCA endpoint
evaluation.per_run_service_success: valid recording AND delay detected on time AND HTTP error detected on time AND zero false service alarms on normal/load AND recovery on time
evaluation.series_service_success: all five planned recordings valid and all five meet per_run_service_success; otherwise report each failure/invalid attempt
evaluation.scientific_scope: Five separate app/model/log recordings on one PC; not independent populations, proof of superiority, zero long-term false-alarm rate, or proof against long-term habituation
evaluation.new_target: Original per-run service success AND zero statistical_alarm on contiguous healthy normal/load span including transition AND IPCA on-time flags for both manifestations. Report all components independently; no selection of a successful record.

warmup_load.after_curriculum: 2 rps until both original readiness checks pass
warmup_load.changes_only: Normal-load distribution before the unchanged test scenario; same 256/128/512 rows, no model/config/threshold changes
warmup_load.actual_coverage_rule: Each first 256/128/512 eligible rows must contain >= one quarter of the part at 1-3 rps and >= one quarter at 6-10 rps, without handler/error requirement violations; report actual counts, not idealized time-slot counts
warmup_load.baseline: saved run-01; different real recordings, not identical observations
